title: Review what your next commit contains
example: One edited application file is staged.
expected: The staged path and its changed-line count.

title: Check the status of a local HTTP service
example: The local service is running and serves /health.
expected: Its response body or curl's error.

title: Start a Bash configuration check
body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ -f "$1" ]; then
  cat -- "$1"
else
  printf '%s\n' {{error}} >&2
  exit 2
fi
example: Run the generated file with an existing configuration path as its first argument.
expected: The file contents on stdout, or the configured error on stderr with status 2.
